description: Get Form 5500 filing detail from the DOL EFAST2 index. Pass ack_id for a single filing (sponsor, plan name/number, participant counts, begin/end-of-year plan assets, plan type, filing date, and full filing PDF URL). Pass ein instead to get a plan sponsor's full filing history (all Form 5500 filings for that EIN, newest first). For an ack_id the response also carries the plan's Schedule H (large plans) or Schedule I (small plans) financial line items - employer / participant / total contributions, income, benefits paid, expenses, assets and liabilities - from the U.S. Department of Labor, EBSA, Form 5500 Schedule H/I datasets (stored copy, data_as_of stated), under schedule_h or schedule_i. schedule_status is always one of h, i, not_filed_sf (5500-SF filers file neither schedule), full_form_no_schedule, not_loaded_year, not_in_dataset_yet, unknown_plan_year, store_unavailable - never a silent null. Schedule C service providers are not included; pdf_url links to the complete filing.

ack_id.description: EFAST2 Acknowledgement ID (the 30-char filing id, e.g. "20230407122300NAL0001820321001"). Returns one filing.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional). Returns the full filing history for that employer.

limit.description: For ein history: max filings to return (1-200, default 50).

name: form5500_filing
